text:
adele-eng: :rotating_light: noticed spike in tail latency on canary after rollout v5.3.0 at 12:02 UTC — requests piling up on node pool B, p95->p99 gap widened. seeing kernel fallback logs and batch window growth
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-8887 - postdeploy canary slowtail + batching fallback. Pager: sanjay-oncall
sanjay-oncall: picking this up. first pass: is this affecting customer-facing traffic or just canary?
adele-eng: only 10% canary traffic, but latency for long sequences jumps from 120ms -> 1.4s tail. throughput per replica down ~30%. kernel fallback lines: 
```
W runtime: kernel_fallback triggered: reason=eviction_threshold; kv_cache_miss=0.42
W batcher: effective_window_ms=120 -> 600
```
ryan-runtime: looks like batcher is inflating window due to spiky microbursts; when the kernel fallback hits we drop to non-optimized path, CPU-bound. That explains slowtail and throughput loss.
lucy-sre: can we confirm any customer errors? logs show 502s?
marta-support: support queue shows 3 customer tickets flagged slow responses from API since 12:05 UTC. None full failures yet but one partner reported user-facing slowness. tagging CS leads.
sanjay-oncall: escalation plan: 1) flip feature flag for v5.3 canary to 0 (kill-switch) 2) if that fails, rollback canary 3) if still bad, scale up pool B and throttle canary traffic. propose flip first.
adele-eng: agreed. flag name `canary/v5.3/enable_new_batcher` — flipping now.
julia-ops: flipping flag through launch darkly... `ldctl set canary/v5.3/enable_new_batcher false --env prod`
incident-bot: Feature flag change recorded (user=julia-ops, flag=canary/v5.3/enable_new_batcher, from=true->false)
ryan-runtime: observing metrics: within 30s p99 reduced from 1.4s -> 220ms, throughput recovering to ~95% baseline. kernel fallback logs dropping. :white_check_mark:
marta-support: updating affected customers: posting proactive note to partner slack channel that we're mitigating and will follow up.
sanjay-oncall: good. keep canary frozen. need root cause investigation: batcher heuristics + kernel shim evictions. tagging ry an & adele to dig into kernel affinity and kv-cache sizing.
adele-eng: collecting traces, saving sample traces to S3 at s3://redwood-ops/canary-v5.3/4176543210/trace.tar.gz. will run perf diff between v5.2 & v5.3 on same workload.
lucy-sre: doing postmortem template start. impact: small # customers slow, no errors; canary traffic only, rollback avoided thanks to flag kill-switch. severity P2.
ryan-runtime: preliminary notes — allocator policy in v5.3 introduced aggressive prefetch that increases memory churn under microburst, causing kernel fallback path to be used for some sequence lengths. batching logic then expanded window to compensate, exacerbating tail.
sanjay-oncall: handoff to ry an & adele for next 6 hours for investigation. i'll remove pager. If anything flips back we re-open incident.
adele-eng: ack. leaving thread for investigation updates. will post patch plan: either tune prefetch heuristic or tighten kernel affinity threshold.
marta-support: will follow up with affected customers with timeline and postmortem when ready.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-8887 marked status=mitigated by sanjay-oncall at 12:14 UTC.
ryan-runtime: adding watchers for longterm: add telemetry to alert on `batch_window_ms > 200 && kernel_fallback_count > 0` so we catch slowtail earlier.
lucy-sre: thanks team. closing notification: will attach full postmortem draft in #postmortems when available. :thumbsup:
